law: The quote convention a codec brings: {pairs, toggle, end, dash}. A language with no entry is a typed gap (no_quote_table), never an English default. This is a SIDECAR to the UDGrammar@1 files (priors/ud-grammar-*.json.gz), merged into G.quotes by nl-eot.mjs loadGrammar; the proper home is the grammar builder (khora scripts/train-ud-language.mjs), which janus cannot edit.
source: copied as data from khora native/adapters/text/quote-frames.js QUOTE_TABLES at khora main ab3c023 (the built-in tables); typographic convention, declared, not measured here. Per EDITION the convention can differ (khora inferQuoteTable reads it from the marks); this is the codec default, the prior.
